note: Three-way lymphoid split on CD19 × CD3. T_Cells: T-lineage cells — upper region (CD3+, CD19-). B_Cells: mature B-lineage cells — right cluster (CD19+, CD3-). Non_BT: non-B non-T mononuclear cells (feeds the monocyte / DC / basophil branches; NK cells reside here) — lower-left cluster (both CD19 and CD3 low).
tips: Lymphocyte lineage split within mononuclear cells. B_Cells: CD19+ CD3-. T_Cells: CD3+ CD19-. Non_BT: CD19- CD3-. In-panel co-marker prior: no other in-panel marker (CD14, CD16, HLA-DR, CD11c, CD123, CD303, CD1c, CD86) is lineage-discriminative for B vs. T — CD3/CD19 are the only lymphoid lineage markers in this panel, so each call is a single positive without an in-panel confirmatory co-marker.
